### Device Information
- **Manufacturer & Brand:** (e.g. Sony, TCL, Philips, Xiaomi, Google, Nvidia)
- **Model:** (e.g. 55C635, Bravia X90J, Shield TV Pro, Chromecast 4K)
- **Android / Google TV Version:** (e.g. Android 9 / 10 / 11 / 12)

### Verification Checklist
- [ ] Launcher boots and renders smoothly (60 fps)
- [ ] D-pad navigation & horizontal shelf rewind work as expected
- [ ] Installed apps open without issue
- [ ] HDMI / Live TV inputs switch correctly
- [ ] Wi-Fi / Network status flydown works
- [ ] Wallpaper rotation works
- [ ] Widevine L1 4K HDR streaming apps (Netflix/Prime) work without issue
- [ ] Google Cast / Chromecast receiver works

### Notes & Observations
Any specific OEM quirks, button mappings, or tips for other users with this device.
